scope: Abaqus 2024 standalone odbAccess probe over a solved 20-element B31 cantilever; records object ownership, vendor sequence behavior, node-set nesting, and JSON conversion only.

selection_basis.reason: Each failure consumed a real standalone Abaqus Python call and the official callable cards do not describe these cross-object container boundaries compactly.

FieldOutput_and_FieldValue.component_data: FieldValue.data follows the owning FieldOutput componentLabels; FieldValue.componentLabels is absent

FieldValueArray.slice: OdbError: Slice for an FieldValue Sequence is not supported

JSON_boundary.FieldOutput.type: Abaqus SymbolicConstant; json.dumps fails, str(value) succeeds
JSON_boundary.FieldValue.data_scalar: numpy.float32 in every probed U/RF/RM/SF/SM/UR field; json.dumps fails, float(value) succeeds

OdbMeshNodeArray_and_OdbSet.instance_nodes: flat OdbMeshNodeArray; integer index, slice, and iteration work; findAt is absent
OdbMeshNodeArray_and_OdbSet.assembly_node_set_nodes: tuple whose entries are per-instance OdbMeshNodeArray objects; iterate the outer tuple, then each inner array
OdbMeshNodeArray_and_OdbSet.failure_explained: Treating assembly_set.nodes as a flat node list yields OdbMeshNodeArray has no attribute label

FieldOutput.getSubset.individual_node_region: accepted an OdbMeshNode and returned one U FieldValue with unchanged U1/U2/U3 componentLabels
